steps.title: Open the privacy settings
steps.text: Open Settings, Privacy & Security and scroll to DNS over HTTPS.

steps.title: Max Protection
steps.text: Choose Max Protection. In the other modes Firefox may fall back to unencrypted DNS.

steps.title: Give it this address
steps.text: Choose a provider, pick Custom and enter this address.

steps.title: Check the setup
steps.text: A few seconds after saving, run this check to see that the device uses this Endpoint.
